title: F.P. Journe Watch Sells for $10.59 Million in Geneva
summary_full: The recent Phillips auction in Geneva set a new benchmark in the luxury watch market, generating an impressive CHF 92 million in total sales. Each timepiece captivated enthusiasts, with every watch successfully sold. A standout piece, the F.P. Journe Chronomètre à Résonance 'Régence', commanded a staggering CHF 8.68 million, alongside notable sales like a Patek Philippe for CHF 6,267,000 and a Cartier watch for CHF 4,815,000.
